result.brief: 提出 CausalNav：基于动作条件因果转移图的世界模型控制器，通过干预模拟与可靠性证书门控实现物理参数漂移下的安全规划与弃权。
result.reason: Action-conditioned transition graph world model with intervention simulation, reliability certificates and abstention for control under physical-parameter shift; directly matches embodied world models and planning.
